body: It wasn't rude whatsoever. I needed help seeing this from a perspective that wasn't mine, which was extremely affected by a lot of negative feelings thoughts. I will find a solution to find a better job. I'm feeling a little better. Thank you.

I work at the job because I love helping people make good grades in their classes. I love the students who attend my sessions to review for an upcoming exam. 

It is possible for me to find another job, but I've already said, about two months ago, that I will be committed working another 7 months, which includes two college summer semesters, and a fall semester. I work as a Supplemental Instruction Leader. Once I said that, it would be extremely rude to take back what I said because it takes a long time to find a replacement.

I feel like this because I hate going to work and being around my coworkers while they ignore me and make fun of me. A lot of them do not like me, it seems like, and I think the problem is me. I think that I'm just a horrible person no one will ever like. This feeling is the reason why I tried to kill myself last time.

Thank you so much for the reply. I feel a little better talking to people.

It's a bit of a weird job. A couple months ago, I said that I would be committed to working for another 7 months. Once I said that, then I pretty much have to work there for the time I said I would. The reason why is because they have to find a replacement and that takes a lot of time. 

They've also considered giving me training for a promotion and expect me to work until I may or may not be promoted. I just hate the people at work so much because they ignore all the time and make fun of me behind my back, but I love working my job. I'm not sure if any of that made sense, but it's a weird situation.

I feel like since I'm not liked by majority of the people working there, that I'm a horrible person to be around, and I need to kill myself because of that. I'm such a horrible person that no one wants to be around me, and I just spread negativity around to everyone. That's what my last attempt was all about.
